name: PEP8
description: PEP 8 -- Style Guide for Python Code, the official Python style guide.

rules.name: Function naming
rules.suggestion: Use lower case with underscores for function names (snake_case).

rules.name: Class naming
rules.suggestion: Use capitalised camel case for class names (CapWords).

rules.name: Constant naming
rules.description: Constant names should be upper case, separated by underscores.
rules.suggestion: Constant names should be all upper case.

rules.name: Comparing to None
rules.description: Compare to None with 'is' or 'is not', not with ==.

rules.name: Comparing to True/False
rules.suggestion: Use the condition directly, e.g. 'if x:' rather than 'if x == True:'.

rules.name: Wildcard imports
rules.suggestion: Import the specific names you need to avoid polluting the namespace.

rules.name: Inline imports
rules.description: Import statements belong at the top of the file, not inside functions.
rules.suggestion: Move all import statements to the top of the file.

rules.name: Exception catching
rules.description: Do not use a bare except clause.
rules.suggestion: Catch a specific exception, e.g. 'except ValueError:', or at least 'except Exception:'.

rules.name: Lambda expressions
rules.description: Do not assign a lambda to a variable; define a function with def instead.
rules.suggestion: Use 'def' to define a named function rather than assigning a lambda.

rules.name: Mutable Default Arguments
rules.description: Do not use a mutable object as a default argument value.
rules.suggestion: Use None as the default and create the mutable object inside the function.

rules.name: Single-line if/for/while
rules.description: Do not put the body of an if/for/while on the same line.
rules.suggestion: Put the block on its own indented line to improve readability.
